page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a baseline clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. It provides a high-capacity baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps to support intensive network communication. The hardware profile is designed for large-scale workloads requiring significant parallel processing capabilities and high network throughput without the need for local disk I/O or graphics acceleration.

Given its resource distribution, the ecs.hfg8i.32xlarge is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, distributed caching, web serving fleets, and application servers that benefit from high-frequency Intel Xeon processors and substantial network capacity.
